scope: Complete B71 complex64:128conditions,8draws each,Q12,80ps;unchanged releasedPVB and originalh/v reference outputs. Separate advanced outputs do not overwrite the queued pairedA/B amplitude analysis.

bins.definition: TRAIN-complex fixed tertiles of sqrt(3*coordinate_second_moment_A2). Validation labels use all valid atoms' real future displacement from fixed last observation in the existing common coordinate frame. Truth is evaluation-only, never condition/source.
bins.aggregation: Average available matched conditions within each system and bin, then equal-system paired bootstrap. A system may enter multiple bins; bins are not disjoint system cohorts. Two undefined observed-pocket windows retained for other metrics, not imputed.

judgment.versus_hv: Bond and RMSF errors improve in every amplitude bin. CenterMSD improves in high motion, worsens in low motion, and is unresolved in medium motion. Center-path improves low/medium but not resolved high; pocket-path improves all bins. Brier/occupancy improve medium/high, not resolved low. Overall improvement is not confined to low-motion examples, but is not uniform across metrics.
judgment.versus_PVB: Ligand bond error remains worse in every bin. High-motion RMSF/centerMSD/center-path differences are unresolved; high-motion pocket-path/Brier/occupancy improve. Low/medium RMSF is worse by marginal intervals, with medium lowerCI only9.8e-7A and not robust evidence under multiplicity. CenterMSD is only marginally better in medium bin. No joint geometry-motion victory.
judgment.next_action: Retain bounded paired temporal-order experiment and complete original A/second-seed/static complex panels. Do not choose a new source/noise recipe from these one-seed stratified errors. Direct amplitude calibration/internal-motion decomposition remains separate; lower RMSF error does not prove absence of suppressed motion.

limitations: Exploratory marginal bootstrap without multiplicity correction
One completed B seed, paired A complex still running
Bins reflect all-atom motion, not ligand-specific motion or dissociation labels
No direct amplitude ratio/distribution calibration established by these error-only metrics
NativePVB H1 versus B H4 and unmatched historical h/v training/resources
Development systems include documented sequence relatives;not sealed/family-clean confirmation
Short-window benefits do not overturn complete rollout chemical failures
